auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Token Metrics API key sent with the x-api-key header. Create or view API keys at https://app.tokenmetrics.com/en/api; authentication is documented at https://developers.tokenmetrics.com/docs/authentication.

actions.name: get_prices
actions.description: Retrieve current Token Metrics price records for selected cryptocurrencies.

anyOf.description: One positive Token Metrics token identifier.
Comma-separated Token Metrics token identifiers, such as 3375,3306.

token_id.description: One Token Metrics token identifier or a comma-separated identifier list.

inputSchema.description: The token identifiers for retrieving current prices.

success.description: Whether Token Metrics completed the request successfully.

message.description: The status message returned by Token Metrics.

items.description: One native Token Metrics v2 price record. Uppercase token and price fields are preserved exactly as returned by the endpoint.

data.description: The price records returned by Token Metrics.

total.description: The total number of matching records.

total_pages.description: The total number of result pages.

limit.description: The page size used by Token Metrics.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata returned by Token Metrics.

length.description: The number of records in the response when reported by Token Metrics.

outputSchema.description: The native Token Metrics price response.
